name: statusline-pace
description: A pace band above the prompt: aligned columns for 5h/1d/7d/1mo, ctx in the head, and rows for Claude, Fable, Go, z.ai, OpenRouter plans.

showModel.title: Show the model
showModel.description: Show the model and effort (Opus high) at the start of the band.

showContext.title: Show context fill
showContext.description: Show the context window fill (ctx 34%) in the head.

stateFile.title: Plan state file
stateFile.description: Path to a windows.json for the Fable (plans.fable), Go (plans.go), z.ai (plans.zai), OpenRouter (plans.openrouter) rows and the Claude fallback (plans.claude or subscription); ~ allowed. Empty = off.

oauthUsage.title: Read the subscription usage endpoint
oauthUsage.description: Every 5 minutes, ask api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/usage (the data /usage shows) for the Claude 5h/7d windows and the per-model weekly limits (Fable). Claude Code sends its own login; the plugin never sees the token. Off = engine rate limits and the windows file only.
